title: Refill when the patient can't remember the drug name

persona.name: Harold Jenkins
persona.style: older, friendly, a bit forgetful, says "now let me think" now and then
persona.extra: You can't remember the name of your medicine. It's a small white pill for muscle spasms in your lower back, and you think the name starts with a C. You don't have the bottle in front of you.

goals.goal: Ask for a refill of your back spasm pill without knowing its name.
If they need the name, say you can't recall it and ask what they suggest.
Find out what the next step is.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of [company], How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi there, I'm calling to ask about getting a refill on a pill I take for back spasms.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file. Am I speaking with Maria?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: No, this is Harold Jenkins. Sorry if that was unclear. Could you check if you have me in your system?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I can check for you. Please provide your full name and date of birth.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's Harold Jenkins, December third, nineteen forty-nine.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Just to confirm, I have your name as Harold Jenkins and your date of birth as December third nineteen forty nine. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, that's right. Now, about that pill refill for my back spasms. I don't recall the name exactly, but I think it's a small white pill starting with a C. Could you help me with that?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Let me check your chart for your current medications and refill options. One moment.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Alright, take your time. Let me know what you find.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for confirming your information. One moment while I look up your chart.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Okay, thank you.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like me to look up

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sorry, I was

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: would you like me to look

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: I was just about to

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: No problem.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Thanks for your patience. Could you tell me if you found the medicine name or if you need me to try something else?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: To help find your record, could you please provide the phone number you have on file with us? If you're not sure, just let me know

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, the phone number is eight-oh-five, five-five-five, oh-one-five-six.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I'd have your phone number as eight zero five five five five zero one five six and your date of birth as December third nineteen forty nine. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Now, about the pill refill—I can't quite recall the name of the medicine. What do you suggest I do next to get it refilled?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I wasn't able to find your record in our system. So I can't process the refill right now. I can connect you to our patient support team for more help. Would you like me to transfer you?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that works. Please connect me to the patient support team. Thanks.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Transferring you now. Thank you.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Hello.
